name: Dura'ek the Empowered

facts.text: Level 71, 30,000 health; Avalon City's raid final. Heat and Cold damage heal him instead of hurting him. Casts Flames of Dura'ek. Pulling him brings six dry'ak avowry.

The drakoran of the city come in five clans whose names echo their lords': drau'gyn (Dra'argus), dry'ak (Dura'ek), syhr'phint (Sys'sro), vyr'em (Vera'erius) and wi'voron (Weno'iak); the lords' linked packs are of their own clan. The clan reading is inferred from names and packs.
An avowry is a patron or protector (Middle English); to verify.

story:
Dura'ek was a war-lord of the dry'ak clan, the halberdiers and doorkeepers of the drakoran host, and no greater than the other four lords until the night Avalon burned. Then he came up from the way under the city changed. Fire and frost, the two breaths of a dragon, no longer harm him; they feed him, and he burns with a flame that is not his own. The other clans call him the Empowered and bow to him, and they whisper that he went down to the Crystal Cave and was given something there. His six avowries, the protectors of his household, never leave his side. He rules the occupied city from the chancellors' court as if he had been born to it.

Before the burning. Dura'ek was a war-lord of the dry'ak, the halberdiers and doorkeepers of the drakoran host, and no greater than the other four lords when the clans crossed to the isles at Morgana's call. The dry'ak hold doors; it is what they are for. When the city fell, they held the doors of the chancellors' court, the heart of Avalon, and Dura'ek with them.

The going down. On the third night of the burning, the readers saw a light rise out of the ground at the city's heart. The clans say Dura'ek went down the way under the court that night, alone, past the Xanxicarian sentries who had already taken the stair, and came back at dawn changed. Fire and frost, the two breaths of a dragon, no longer harm him; they feed him, and he burns with a flame that is not his own, the Flames of Dura'ek that he throws into the ranks of his enemies. The other lords bowed to him that morning. They have not stopped bowing.

What he is now. He rules the occupied city from the chancellors' court as though he had been born to it, with six dry'ak avowries, his sworn protectors, never more than a step away. He calls himself the city's lord; his clans call him the Empowered and whisper the question every Albion raider asks: empowered by whom. The Camelot loremasters think they know, and so does the drakoran guard on the stair below him.
legend:
Heat and cold heal him. Leave the fire and ice wizards on his avowries, and bring every other damage type to him: steel, matter, body, spirit, energy. Kill the six protectors first. Empowered by whom? Ask the dragon under the city.

Steel, body, spirit, matter and energy all hurt him; it is only the dragon's two breaths he drinks. The raids that lost to Dura'ek in 2003 lost because a wizard forgot. Fight him in the court, not the street outside, where the whole dry'ak clan waits. His Flames land in the ranks every few seconds; spread out and keep the casters well back from the chair.

loremasterTopic.text: The Empowered. He rules the city from its heart, and fire and frost only feed him. The clans whisper that his power is not his own. I think they are right, and I think I know whose it is.

bookPage: My fishermen say the greatest of the dragon-men's lords sits in the court of our chancellors and is called the Empowered, and that his own people do not believe the power is his. They say he went down the stair under the court on the third night of the burning, when we saw the light rise, and came up at dawn changed. One of them saw a wizard of the Inconnu throw fire at him in the street and watched the drakoran lord stand in the flame and grow stronger. Frost the same. Steel, the fisherman said, steel he did not like at all.
